key_insight: LLMs and VLMs translate human purposes expressed in natural language into robot missions and motivational drives to guide autonomous behavior.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a way to connect human intent with the internal motivations of open-ended learning robots using multimodal context and interactive feedback.
method: Use three layers: semantic alignment, mission generation, and drive modeling.
Combine language inputs with multimodal information to generate executable missions.
Maintain a bidirectional feedback loop between human purposes and robot behavior.
evidence_signal: Simulation and physical-robot experiments produced valid missions and behaviors, though the abstract provides no quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: Robustness to ambiguous instructions and incorrect LLM/VLM interpretations remains an implementation concern not resolved by the abstract.
paper_title: From Language to Drives: A Multimodal Framework for Aligning Autonomous Robots with Human Purposes
